I hope you're doing well. I'm following up on my affiliate commission
payout.

My dashboard currently shows $1,421.10 in approved commissions. These cover
orders from September 18 to October 31, 2026, and many of them have been
completed and approved for over 2 months now, but I have not yet received
payment.

Could you please let me know:
1. The exact date this $1,421.10 will be processed and paid?
2. Whether there is anything on my side (payment details or verification)
that is delaying the payout?

I'd really appreciate a clear timeline so I can plan accordingly. Please
let me know if you need any information from me.

Thank you for your time and support.

Best regards,
Abigail L.

I've passed both of your questions to the team that handles affiliate payments. They have the $1,421.10 in approved commissions for orders from September 18 to October 31, and they know this is your third request. They'll pick it up tomorrow when they're back at 10am ET. The reply will come to this email address with the payout date, and with what they need from you if anything is missing.

You don't need to send anything else for now.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
